ios.desc:
Outbox: Declutter Your Inbox in Seconds
Tired of missing important emails buried under countless newsletters and promotions? Outbox makes unsubscribing from unwanted emails effortless, freeing up your inbox so you can focus on what truly matters. Spend less time scrolling and more time reading the messages that count.

WHY OUTBOX?
. Addictively Simple: Swipe left to unsubscribe or swipe right to keep. No more searching for hidden “unsubscribe” links.
. Instant Cleanups: Delete thousands of junk emails with just a few taps.
. One-Click Multi-Unsubscribe: Tired of unsubscribing sender by sender? Outbox allows you to remove multiple senders at once.
. Reclaim Storage Space: Track exactly how much storage your emails occupy and free it up instantly.
. Peace of Mind: Focus on urgent emails instead of drowning in promotional clutter.
. Built for Gmail: Connect securely with your Gmail account for a streamlined, instant setup.
. Dark Mode: Clean your inbox anytime with a theme that’s easy on the eyes.

FEATURES THAT SAVE YOU TIME
. Bulk Unsubscribe Mode: Unsubscribe from multiple senders with a single tap.
. Subscription Sorting: Sort by frequency, size, or how often you open emails - so you can tackle the worst offenders first.
. One-Tap Cleanup: Choose to unsubscribe, delete, or mark messages as read - all in one place.
. Undo Swipes: Accidentally swipe the wrong way? No problem - easily undo for 24 hours.

PRIVACY- FOCUSED
Your data and email content are safe with us. Outbox never stores the content of your emails or sells your data. We only use minimal inbox information - like sender addresses and unsubscribe links—to provide essential details and ensure a secure, seamless experience.

BETTER THAN COMPETITORS
Other apps like Trimbox and Unroll.me can be clunky and complex. Outbox keeps it simple, with a clean interface in both light and dark modes - no extra gimmicks, no clutter, just results. Achieving inbox zero has never been so straightforward.

TAKE BACK CONTROL OF YOUR INBOX
Stop letting unwanted emails bury the ones that matter. Thousands have already rescued their inboxes from subscription overload - be next. Download Outbox now and experience true email freedom!
